name: Boushiya
source:
A somewhat strange, incredibly narcissistic guy who's nearly always accompanied by a pair of easily-jealous, sleeping dormice. He and the doormice girls hold a tea parties all year. Once Boushiya starts talking about his own beauty, he never stops. He sometimes experiences withdrawal symptoms, but from where this comes from is unknown.

[Based on the [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/alice/#chara4]official website's character profile[/URL].]
